A graduate of Ecole Polytechnique and Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chaussees, she began her career at Boston Consulting Group in 1997, joining Alcatel in 1999 and rising to Alcatel-Lucent's French executive committee as sales director for France in 2008 and head of human resources and transformation in 2011.
